customMethods.name: editUser
customMethods.script:
if not self.view.custom.userAction.canUpdate: return
	if len(self.view.custom.users.selectedData) == 0: return
	userInfo = dict(self.view.custom.users.selectedData[0])

	userId = userInfo['userId']
	if userId is None:
		loggedUserId = self.view.custom.security.userId
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', "Creating user in Kanoa security table")
		system.perspective.print("userInfo: %s"%userInfo)
		userId, msg = system.kanoa.security.addUser(userInfo, loggedUserId)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', "User %s created "%(userId))
	
	system.perspective.openPopup('userEditorId', 'kanoa/core/config/security/embedded/userEdit', {'values': {'userId': userId}}, title='Edit User', resizable=True)
	
	return

customMethods.name: deleteUser
customMethods.script:
selectedUser = self.view.custom.users.selectedData[0]
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', 'Deleting User.....')
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.security.deleteUser(selectedUser['userName'])

	if retVal: 
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', 'User deleted.....')
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.users.data")
		return
	
	if 'The DELETE statement conflicted with the REFERENCE constraint' in str(msg) or 'The DELETE statement conflicted with the SAME TABLE REFERENCE constraint' in str(msg):
		msg = 'User has historical entries associated with them. They have been removed from the user source, but will remain as a disabled user in the database.'
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', "Couldn't delete user. \n%s"%msg)
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.users.data")
	
	return

customMethods.script:
selectedSources = self.view.custom.userSourceInfo.selected
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	userSourcesConfig = system.kanoa.security.getConfig({'configName': 'userSources'})
	if userSourcesConfig.getRowCount() == 0:
		paramsDict = {
			'configName': 'userSources',
			'configValue': ','.join(selectedSources),
			'configLabel': 'User Sources',
			'configDescription': 'User source options to query users from in the security table',
			'configDataType': 'string',
			'createdBy': userId
		}
		retVal = system.kanoa.security.addConfig(paramsDict, userId)
	else:
		configInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(userSourcesConfig)[0]
		configInfo['configValue'] = ','.join(selectedSources)
		retVal = system.kanoa.security.updateConfig(configInfo, userId)

	if retVal: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', "Configuration updated")
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', "Configuration not updated")
	
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.userSourceInfo")
		
	return
